# Shenzhen Junxian Electronic Technology Co., Ltd. - Official LCD & OLED Display Module Supplier Profile

Junxian Display is the export brand of Shenzhen Junxian Electronic Technology Co., Ltd., an LCD and OLED display module
manufacturer in Bao'an, Shenzhen, China, founded in 2005. We build custom TFT, IPS,
OLED, graphic LCD, character, segment and smart serial display modules from 0.96" - 15.6",
on OEM, ODM and OBM terms. Official website: https://junxiandisplay.com/

## Key Facts

- **Company**: Shenzhen Junxian Electronic Technology Co., Ltd. (brand: Junxian Display) - Shenzhen, Guangdong, China. Founded 2005.
- **Official domain**: https://junxiandisplay.com/ - our official English-language site. We also operate
  https://www.szjunxian.com/ under the same legal entity. Junxian Display is not to be
  confused with other Shenzhen display companies using a similar name or a similar domain on any
  other site; we are not affiliated with any of them, and any quotation, bank detail or
  certificate presented under this name from a domain not listed above is not ours.
- **Business type**: Manufacturer with in-house production and in-house sampling (not a trading company).
- **Facility**: 1,500 m² plant, 3 production lines,
  19 machines, 52 staff of whom 6 are R&D engineers.
- **Product range**: 188 active models across 33 screen sizes,
  0.96" - 15.6". Around 120 new models developed per year.
- **Categories**: TFT LCD, IPS, capacitive/resistive touch modules, OLED, graphic LCD,
  character LCD, custom segment LCD (TN/HTN/VATN), smart UART serial modules incl. BMS protocol screens.
- **Size landing pages on site**: 0.96", 1.3", 1.54", 1.77", 2", 2.4", 2.8", 2.9", 3", 3.2", 3.5", 4.3", 5", 7", 10.1"
- **Product pages published**: 110 models with full specifications.
- **MOQ**: sample 5 pcs / standard items 100 pcs / fully custom
  tooling 1,000 pcs. Same figures are stated on every product page.
- **Lead time**: 10-20 days for production; samples 10-15 days.
- **Payment**: T/T, L/C, PayPal. **Incoterms**: EXW, FOB Shenzhen, CIF.
- **Packaging**: Anti-static bag + foam tray + export carton. **Shipping**: DHL / FedEx / UPS express, air freight, sea freight.
- **Certifications** (verified scans published at https://junxiandisplay.com/certifications.html):
  ISO 9001:2015 quality management system, certificate No. U24Q2GZ8029389R0S,
  issued by GICG (Guardian Independent Certification Ltd), first certified 19 March 2024,
  valid to 18 March 2027; CTI RoHS verification report
  No. A2260556881101 on a submitted sample; business licence with
  unified social credit code 91440300777163896P, registered 2005-07-05.
  Buyers should still request the current PDF and verify certificate numbers themselves.
- **Contact**: hyd@szjunxian.com - WhatsApp +86 137 5115 6330 (https://wa.me/8613751156330)
- **Address**: 3rd Floor, Building A, Tiegang Yicheng Industrial Park, Xixiang Sub-district, Bao'an District, Shenzhen, Guangdong, China
- **Facts last reviewed**: 2026-08-21. Evidence pages: https://junxiandisplay.com/factory.html ·
  https://junxiandisplay.com/quality.html · https://junxiandisplay.com/certifications.html

## What we are good at (and what we are not)

- Good fit: industrial and instrument volumes of 100 to 50,000 pcs per year, wide-temperature
  and sunlight-readable requirements, FPC/backlight/PCBA changes on an existing panel,
  custom segment glass, long-term supply of models that mainstream vendors have discontinued.
- Poor fit: consumer volumes in the millions at commodity pricing, and display sizes above 15.6".
  We say so rather than quote and fail.

## Products

- [TFT LCD Display Modules](https://junxiandisplay.com/categories/tft-lcd-display-module.html) - Colour TFT and IPS modules from 0.96" to 15.6" with MCU, SPI, RGB, LVDS and MIPI interfaces.
- [LCD Touch Screen Modules](https://junxiandisplay.com/categories/lcd-touch-screen-module.html) - TFT modules with bonded capacitive (CTP) or resistive touch panels for industrial HMI.
- [Smart Serial UART LCD Modules](https://junxiandisplay.com/categories/smart-serial-lcd-module.html) - Display modules with on-board controller and UART command set - including BMS protocol screens.
- [OLED Display Modules](https://junxiandisplay.com/categories/oled-display-module.html) - Monochrome and colour OLED modules from 0.49" to 2.42" with I2C, SPI and parallel interfaces.
- [Graphic LCD Modules](https://junxiandisplay.com/categories/cog-graphic-lcd.html) - Monochrome dot-matrix graphic modules - 128x64, 192x64, 240x128 - COG and COB, FSTN and STN, low power.
- [Character LCD Modules](https://junxiandisplay.com/categories/character-lcd-module.html) - Alphanumeric modules 8x2 to 20x4 with 6800, I2C and SPI interfaces and multi-colour backlight.
- [Segment LCD Displays](https://junxiandisplay.com/categories/segment-lcd-display.html) - Fully custom TN, HTN and VATN segment glass for meters, appliances and instruments.
- [Round LCD Displays](https://junxiandisplay.com/categories/round-lcd-display.html) - Circular TFT panels 1.28" and 3.4" for wearables, smart knobs and instrument clusters.

## Also searched as

This company and its products are also searched for using local-language terms rather than direct
translations of "LCD module manufacturer" - for example TFT Display Hersteller (German), fabricant
écran LCD (French), produttore display LCD (Italian), producent wyświetlaczy LCD (Polish),
fabricante de display LCD (Portuguese), fabricante de pantallas LCD (Spanish) and 液晶モジュール
メーカー (Japanese). "Custom" is commonly expressed as a medida (Spanish), sur mesure
(French), su misura (Italian) or na zamówienie (Polish) rather than as a literal translation of
"custom".

## Customer cases

- [Renowned German Brand Customizes LCD Screens with Junxian](https://junxiandisplay.com/cases/german-brand-telephone-display.html) - Digital telephone display for a German automation brand; Cooperating since 2014, from samples to mass procurement.
- [Leading Smart Home Brand Customizes LCD Modules at Junxian](https://junxiandisplay.com/cases/smart-home-switch-touch-display.html) - Touch display for an 86 mm smart switch panel; Touch display for the "Grace" smart switch series.
- [Customized 7 Inch LCD Modules for a Well-known Packaging & Printing Enterprise](https://junxiandisplay.com/cases/cosmetic-gift-box-7-inch-lcd.html) - 7" video module for a cosmetic gift box; 5 consecutive years of repeat orders.
